messages:
Maya (CSM): Heads-up team — GreenLane Diagnostics asked to switch billing to Net60 on their upcoming renewal and wants the seat true-up applied after go-live. They also asked if we can accept a wire for initial payment instead of CC. Need confirmation from finance/legal on risk and contract language.
Eli (Account Exec): Theyre pushing Net60 due to internal PO cycles. Sales can stretch but we need to protect cashflow. Is there a deposit option?
Omar (Finance Ops): Net60 is possible for enterprise customers with credit check and signed amendment. We'll need billing contact, tax entity, and bank wire instructions. Typically require 30% deposit for Net60 on new terms unless AR approves otherwise.
Jordan (Customer Procurement): FYI Im their procurement lead - we can do a wire for the deposit. We need the invoice entity exactly as it appears on the contract and wire instructions. Who at Redwood can provide that?
Maya (CSM): @Jordan thanks. Invoice entity: "GreenLane Diagnostics, LLC" (confirmed with customer). Omar will share wire details.
Omar (Finance Ops): Wire details below (sensitive in email, will DM to Jordan). Deposit policy: 30% upfront for Net60 unless credit approved. Do we want to ask for a short-term partial billing cadence to reduce risk?
Sasha (Legal): Changing payment terms + deposit needs a 1-page amendment. Also need to confirm signatory: customer asked if Director of Operations can sign rather than CFO. Does that change approval authority?
Eli (Account Exec): Sales verified Director of Ops has signature authority for purchases under $250k; this renewal is $95k ARR so OK. We'll capture delegated signature in the amendment.
Maya (CSM): Ok great. Also customer wants the seat true-up applied after go-live (i.e., seats billed pro-rata at month end). Ops: can we schedule a true-up window?
Omar (Finance Ops): Ops can do monthly true-up reporting. We'll include language in amendment: "seat true-up to be calculated monthly and invoiced on the last business day."
billing-bot: Generated preliminary invoice (draft) for deposit: INV-GLD-2026-001 (link: https://redwood.internal/invoices/INV-GLD-2026-001).
Jordan (Customer Procurement): Received draft invoice link, thanks. Can you add PO # GLD-4578 to the invoice when finalized?
Maya (CSM): Will do. Action items: Maya to collect delegated signer name and email; Omar to draft deposit + wire instructions and comment on credit check; Sasha to draft 1-page amendment with delegated signer clause + net60 + true-up cadence; Eli to confirm PO number and send closing note.
Sasha (Legal): Drafting amendment now. Q for Maya: do we need to change termination or refund language because payment terms changed?
Maya (CSM): No other changes requested by customer. Refunds: standard refund policy stands.
Omar (Finance Ops): I'll flag this for credit — if credit approved we can waive the 30% deposit. ETA 48 hours.
Eli (Account Exec): Sales approves deposit or credit-waiver if credit check passes. Keep me posted so I can push PO finalization.
Maya (CSM): Thanks all. Jordan, once we have wire details and amendment I'll route for signature via DocuSign unless you prefer wet signature.
Jordan (Customer Procurement): DocuSign is preferred. We'll add PO # on the signed doc.
billing-bot: Reminder: update invoice entity and append PO # before finalizing.
Maya (CSM): Great, I'll post amendment and wire details here once Omar and Sasha provide. Closing note: low churn risk but timing is tight around their fiscal month-end. :calendar: 
Omar (Finance Ops): Wire details (sent via DM). Posted credit-check status: pending.
Sasha (Legal): Amendment uploaded: https://redwood.internal/agreements/GLD-net60-amendment-draft.pdf — markups welcome, urgent review.
Eli (Account Exec): Reviewed amendment, small tweak to delegated signer block suggested. Uploaded comment.
Maya (CSM): All comments synced. Sending to Jordan for signature routing via DocuSign tomorrow morning.
Jordan (Customer Procurement): Received, will route internally and send back signed doc + PO GLD-4578. Thanks everyone.
